messages:
Leah (CS): heads up — Auric Analytics just asked to expand to ap-southeast-1 (SG) for a live demo next week and need a temporary QPS bump for the demo traffic. They also want an IP allowlist entry for a new demo fleet. renewal is coming up in May, flagged as medium risk if we don't get this greenlit. assigning @Tomas and @Ravi to confirm infra and security.
Ravi (Support): noted. can you paste the CIDR and expected qps? also any cert/mTLS requirements for the demo endpoints?
Eden (Auric Analytics): thanks! CIDR is 198.51.100.0/24. We'll aim for ~200 rps sustained, spike up to ~300 rps during a short demo window. No mTLS for the demo, but we'll need TLS. Demo scheduled Wed 10:00 SGT. Can you confirm before Tue EOD? :pray: 
Tomas (NetOps): ok, SG region available. will need a short maintenance window to attach the route. quick question — are they ok with a temporary routing tag (region:ap-southeast-1-demo) so we can isolate traffic? also need an internal IP for health checks.
Leah (CS): yes to routing tag. health check IP will come from Auric's fleet — Eden, can you confirm the secondary IPs? we'll add only the primary CIDR now and add more if needed.
Eden (Auric Analytics): adding the secondary net too: 2001:db8:85a3::/64 (they're dual-stack). primary demo hosts: 198.51.100.10, .11. thank you!
ops-bot: created ticket CS-4872 — "auric-analytics: ap-southeast-1 demo qps bump + allowlist". Assigning to netops and infra. ETA 1 business day.
Tomas (NetOps): prepping config. plan to set temp rate limit override:
```
allowlist:
  - 198.51.100.0/24
  - 2001:db8:85a3::/64
rate_limit_override:
  qps: 250
  burst: 300
  window: 60s
regions:
  - ap-southeast-1 (demo)
```
Will roll this at 09:00 SGT Wed and revert at 13:00 SGT. any objections?
Ravi (Support): looks good. note that for the demo window we'll enable extra logging and a short-lived retention policy for traces. Leah, I'll also attach a renewal note in the CRM: highlight demo success as upsell trigger for May renewal.
Leah (CS): perfect. action items: @Tomas implement and validate by Tue EOD; @Ravi toggle demo logging + add CRM note; @Eden confirm any last-minute host IPs by Tue 12:00 SGT. I'll follow up with a quick playbook for the demo owners. :thumbsup:
